lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Primary nodes show a grid-like distribution with approximately 4-5 spots per vertical column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the upper edge to lower-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two symbiotic fish (remoras) swimming adjacent to the ventral surface near the pectoral fin.
